why: A random call records the seed it shuffled the margin with, so the same book and seed clear to the same trades (fm-server#1073). The seed is drawn below 2^53: read as a double and rounded to a neighbour, it names a different shuffle, and a replay of the call no longer matches what traded.

source.constructed: fm-server's MarketCall record (4.31.0) as GET /marketplaces/{id}/calls and the CALL-UPDATE frame send it: a manual call on a RANDOM market that cleared, with the largest seed the server draws, 2^53 - 1, calledDate zone-less in UTC with milliseconds.
